description: Ministry of Higher Education & Highways - Order to amend the Schedule to the Order establishing the University of Sri Jayawardenepura, Sri Lanka by addition of a new item
reasoning: This gazette notification amends the schedule of a university by adding a new department (Department of Criminology and Criminal Justice). While it involves a government minister making the order, the content primarily concerns educational administration and university structure rather than government personnel changes, portfolio assignments, or organizational restructuring of government ministries. This falls under educational matters, which is classified as Miscellaneous (Type 10) according to the guidelines.
